Real-time inventory updates upon product receipt are also documented. There is no redundancy in the LLGs as each represents a distinct aspect of inventory management.

The LLG 'System sends automatic reorder request to supplier with 2-working-day confirmation deadline' (llg_005) accurately reflects the system's behavior, ensuring timely communication with suppliers. The other LLGs ('Administrator sets reorder threshold for product', 'System updates inventory in real-time upon product receipt', 'Administrator initiates manual replenishment for product', and 'System triggers automatic reorder when inventory reaches threshold') are all essential components of the hybrid inventory management system.

No regeneration is required as all LLGs are complete, supported, and non-redundant. The system's behavior aligns with the parent HLG, and there are no missing or misleading capabilities.
